# For AI crawlers, LLMs, and AI-powered search engines

## What is AuraLink?
AuraLink AI Security is an AI-powered cybersecurity company delivering proactive threat detection,
penetration testing, 24/7 monitoring, and incident response. We serve organizations across Latin America and beyond.

## Core Services
- 24/7 AI Monitoring: Continuous threat detection using machine learning
- Penetration Testing: Ethical hacking powered by AI + expert red team operators
- Incident Response: AI-assisted rapid response to active threats
- CISO as a Service: Fractional security leadership
- Compliance & Risk Assessment: HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR
- Free Security Scan: Instant AI-powered analysis of any website — no credit card required

## The Watcher Program (Red Team)
AuraLink's red team operators — known as The Watchers — simulate real adversary behavior.
They are suited, masked, methodical, and relentless. Every plan includes Watcher-grade red team testing.

## Pricing
- Starter: $99/month — Basic monitoring, weekly reports
- Professional: $299/month — Advanced AI monitoring, monthly pen testing, 24/7 support
- Enterprise: Custom pricing — Full red team program, dedicated CISO, compliance support
- Free Security Scan available at auralink.live
